title: Databricks SDK models artifact repo: single-stream download and /Models/ paths bypass presigned multipart download
answers: Downloading a large UC registered model file fails or uses the wrong download path; why does multipart presigned download not apply to SDK-backed models?
How does mlflow recognize a /Models/ path as a managed Databricks location rather than a local or cloud path?
Where is the decision to use a single stream versus parallel chunked download for a cloud artifact repo?
body:
Path: Download of individual model artifact files in `mlflow/store/artifact/cloud_artifact_repo.py:CloudArtifactRepository._download_file`, plus the local-path check `mlflow/utils/uri.py:is_fuse_or_uc_volumes_uri`. Used whenever a UC model artifact is fetched and a file is large, or when a local path is a Databricks-managed location.
Rule: `_download_file` chooses the single-stream `_download_from_cloud` path when the class name is `DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository`, because that repo can only fetch through the SDK, not via the presigned URL used by `_parallelized_download_from_cloud`. The check is a class-name string comparison in the guard, so a renamed class silently loses this behavior. `is_fuse_or_uc_volumes_uri` also treats `/Models/` as a Databricks-managed prefix (`_UC_MODELS_URI_PREFIX`) alongside `/Volumes/` and FUSE paths, so such local paths are not treated as ordinary local storage.
Constraints: The single-stream guard only affects the SDK models repo; other cloud repos keep the parallel presigned path for files above `MLFLOW_MULTIPART_DOWNLOAD_MINIMUM_FILE_SIZE`. The `/Models/` prefix match applies to any path that starts with that segment, not only UC model downloads.
applies: Multipart or parallel download decisions for cloud artifact repos and the Databricks-managed path check, when the SDK models repo is in use.
says: Downloading a large Unity Catalog registered model file fails or uses the wrong download method
Large model artifacts from Databricks SDK-backed models do not use parallel multipart download
Model files under a Models path are treated as local storage instead of Databricks-managed
search: Model artifact downloads from the Databricks SDK models repo use a single stream instead of presigned multipart download, chosen by a class-name check in the cloud artifact download path, so renaming the class silently loses it. Local paths starting with the Models segment are treated as Databricks-managed alongside Volumes and FUSE paths. Other cloud repos keep parallel download.
